01 / The shared visual target

Original character identities, low-poly forms, deliberate shadow bands, painted accents and selective outlines. Ivory stone, teal enamel, bronze structure and living gardens remain the environment language. This generated board proposes composition and style only; the measured masters govern geometry, scale and gameplay.

05 / Production order and approval gates

Headless Blender and Unity jobs are the default. Work stops for Sanders' approval at each major gate. No public package is replaced before final approval.
